text: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the middle of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden.
note: wonder at the mystery of love

keywords: way of an eagle in the air
tags.when_helps: Someone newly in love or struck by wonder at mysteries they cannot explain.

display_text: There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the middle of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden.
plain: Some things are too wonderful to understand: how an eagle flies, how a snake moves on rock, how a ship crosses the sea, and how a man and a young woman come together.
core_idea: Some ways of the world are beyond understanding

text: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise: the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer. note: feeling small but capable

tags.when_helps: Someone who feels small or weak, reminded that wisdom matters more than strength.

display_text: There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise: the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer. The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks. The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks. You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
plain: Four small creatures are very wise: ants store food in summer, rock badgers make homes in cliffs, locusts march in order with no king, and a lizard you can catch lives in palaces.
core_idea: Small and weak things can be very wise

text: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate. Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.
note: speaking up for others

tags.when_helps: Someone troubled by injustice to the vulnerable, called to speak up for them.

display_text: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate. Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.
plain: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves and for everyone left with nothing. Speak up, judge fairly, and see that the poor and needy get justice.
core_idea: Speak up for the voiceless and the poor

text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
note: character over appearance

tags.when_helps: A believer anxious about looks or charm, reminded that character and faith endure.

display_text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
plain: Charm can deceive and beauty doesn't last, but a woman who reveres God deserves praise.
core_idea: Reverence for God outlasts charm and beauty

text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. note: Choosing good company; steady, rooted growth over time

tags.when_helps: A believer choosing between influences and company, wanting a picture of a rooted, fruitful life.

display_text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night. He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
plain: Happy is the person who doesn't follow the wicked or mock, but loves God's law and thinks on it day and night. They are like a well-watered tree that bears fruit and doesn't wither.
core_idea: Delight in God's law makes a life flourish

plain_judge.issue: Compresses the three-fold avoidance and drops "whatever he does shall prosper".

text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
note: Fear when many seem against you; rest despite it

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels surrounded by opposition and cannot sleep, needing trust that they are held.

display_text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
plain: I lay down and slept, and I woke up again, because God keeps me going. I won't be afraid even of the thousands who surround me as enemies.
core_idea: God sustains me, so I need not fear

text: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
note: Anger or turmoil; quiet self-examination before acting

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone stirred up at night, tempted to act in anger, who needs to pause and look inward first.

display_text: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
plain: Stand in awe and don't do wrong. Lying in bed, look honestly into your own heart, and be still.
core_idea: Search your heart in stillness

text: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us. You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
note: Discouragement; joy deeper than material gain

tags.when_helps: A believer surrounded by gloomy talk who wonders where any good is, seeking a gladness deeper than prosperity.

display_text: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us. You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
plain: Many people ask who will ever show them anything good. The psalmist asks God to shine on them, saying God has given more joy than a rich harvest brings.
core_idea: God's favour gives more joy than plenty

text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
note: Anxiety at night; finding peace to sleep

tags.when_helps: A believer lying awake with worry who needs a simple trust that lets them sleep.

display_text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
plain: I can lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, God, keep me safe.
core_idea: Peaceful sleep comes from trusting God

text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears. My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
note: Exhausting grief; crying through the nights

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone crying through the nights, worn out by grief and opposition, who needs to know such sorrow is human.

display_text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears. My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
plain: I am worn out from groaning. Every night I soak my bed with tears, and grief and my enemies have made my eyes weak and old.
core_idea: Grief can exhaust and overwhelm a person

text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained; what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
note: Feeling small under the night sky; wonder at being cared for

tags.when_helps: Someone under a night sky feeling small, wondering whether they matter in so vast a universe.

display_text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained; what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
plain: Looking at the sky God made, the moon and the stars, the psalmist wonders why God would think of or care for human beings at all.
core_idea: Why would God care for small humans?

text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
note: Feeling oppressed or overwhelmed; refuge in trouble

tags.when_helps: A believer feeling oppressed or in trouble who needs a sense of shelter and not being abandoned.

display_text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
plain: God will be a strong refuge for the oppressed and for anyone in trouble. Those who know God trust God, because God has never abandoned those who seek him.
core_idea: God is a refuge who never abandons seekers

text: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me? How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
note: Prolonged sorrow; feeling forgotten and abandoned

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels forgotten by God after long sorrow and needs to know that crying 'how long' is allowed.

display_text: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me? How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
plain: How long, God? Will you forget me forever and hide from me? How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and carry sorrow every day while my enemy wins?
core_idea: Crying out to God in long sorrow

text: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill? He who does these things shall never be shaken.
note: Integrity; keeping your word even when it costs you

keywords: keeps an oath even when it hurts
tags.when_helps: Someone weighing whether to keep their word or speak honestly when it costs them, wanting a steady standard.

display_text: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill? He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart; He who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man; In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change; he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. plain: Who may live close to God? The one who lives with integrity, tells the truth, doesn't slander or harm others, keeps promises even when it hurts, and takes no bribes. Such a person will never be shaken.
core_idea: An honest, faithful life stands unshaken

plain_judge.issue: Drops honouring the God-fearing, despising the vile, and refusing usury.

text: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure. The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance. I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons. I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
note: Contentment and gratitude for one’s lot in life

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels thankful for their lot and wants words for a settled, grateful heart.

display_text: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure. The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance. I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons. I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
plain: God has given me my share in life and made it secure, and it is a good one. I keep God always before me, so I will not be shaken.
core_idea: Keeping God near, I stay steady and content

plain_judge.issue: Drops blessing Yahweh for counsel and the heart instructing at night.

text: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid. The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me. In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
note: Overwhelming fear and distress; crying out for help

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels hemmed in by danger or darkness and needs assurance their cry is heard.

display_text: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid. The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me. In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
plain: Death and evil wrapped around me and terrified me. In my distress I called out to God, and God heard my cry.
core_idea: In deep distress, God heard my cry

text: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness. For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
note: Darkness lifting; courage to face obstacles

tags.when_helps: A believer facing an obstacle that seems too big, needing courage and a sense of strength beyond their own.

display_text: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness. For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
plain: God lights my lamp and brightens my darkness. With God's help I can charge through an army and leap over a wall.
core_idea: God lights my darkness and gives strength

text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork. Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge. There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
note: Awe at nature; meaning speaking without words

tags.when_helps: Someone moved by the sky or the natural world who senses it speaks of something greater.

display_text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork. Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge. There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
plain: The sky proclaims God's glory and shows what God has made. Every day and night it speaks without words, and its message reaches everywhere.
core_idea: The heavens speak wordlessly of God

text: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors. Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression. Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
note: Guilt and blind spots; wanting to do right

tags.when_helps: A believer aware they have faults they cannot fully see, wanting to be cleansed and live with integrity.

display_text: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors. Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression. Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
plain: No one can see all their own faults, so the psalmist asks God to forgive hidden ones, guard against deliberate wrongs, and accept his words and thoughts.
core_idea: Asking God to forgive faults we cannot see

plain_judge.issue: Drops the hope of being blameless and "my rock and my redeemer".

text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God. They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
note: Where to place trust when power and resources fail

tags.when_helps: A believer tempted to rely only on resources and power, reminded where deeper security lies.

display_text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God. They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
plain: Some people trust in chariots and horses, but we trust in God. They have fallen down, while we get up and stand firm.
core_idea: Trust God rather than military strength

text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning? My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
note: Feeling abandoned; prayers that seem unanswered

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels abandoned by God, praying without answer, who needs to know others have cried the same.

display_text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning? My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
plain: My God, why have you abandoned me? Why are you so far from helping me? I cry out day and night, and you don't answer.
core_idea: Feeling abandoned by God and unanswered

text: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me. My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
note: Utter exhaustion and despair; feeling emptied out

tags.when_helps: Someone utterly drained in body and spirit who needs their depletion named rather than fixed.

display_text: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me. My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
plain: I feel poured out and broken: my bones out of joint, my heart melted, my strength dried up, my mouth parched. You have brought me near death.
core_idea: Utter physical and emotional exhaustion

text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
note: Fear in dark times; rest, restoration, not walking alone

keywords: valley of the shadow of death
tags.when_helps: A believer walking through loss, illness or danger who needs comfort that they are guided and not alone.

display_text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
plain: God is my shepherd, so I have all I need. God gives me rest, restores me and guides me rightly. Even in the darkest valley I won't fear, because you are with me and comfort me.
core_idea: With God as shepherd, I fear nothing

plain_judge.issue: Drops "for his name's sake" and the rod and staff; paths of righteousness loosened.

text: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
note: Uncertainty about direction; asking for guidance

tags.when_helps: A believer unsure which way to go, waiting and asking for guidance.

display_text: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
plain: Show me your ways, God, and teach me. Lead me in your truth, because you are the God who saves me, and I wait for you all day.
core_idea: Asking God for guidance and waiting on him

text: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
note: Regret over past mistakes; hoping for mercy

tags.when_helps: A believer haunted by mistakes from earlier years who hopes to be seen with kindness rather than judgement.

display_text: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
plain: Don't hold the wrongs of my youth against me, God. Remember me through your loving kindness and goodness instead.
core_idea: Asking God to remember love, not past sins

text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses. Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
note: Loneliness and mounting troubles

tags.when_helps: A believer feeling desolate and heavy-hearted, longing for mercy and relief from their troubles.

display_text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses. Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
plain: Turn to me and be merciful, God, because I am lonely and suffering. My troubles keep growing. Rescue me, see my pain, and forgive all my wrongs.
core_idea: A lonely plea to God for mercy

text: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
note: Fear; finding inner strength

tags.when_helps: A believer facing something frightening who needs a confident reminder of where their strength comes from.

display_text: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
plain: God is my light, my rescue and my strength, so whom should I fear?
core_idea: With God as my light, I fear no one

text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
note: Rejection or abandonment by family

tags.when_helps: A believer rejected or abandoned by their parents who needs to know they are still held.

display_text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
plain: Even if my father and mother abandon me, God will take me in.
core_idea: God takes in those whom family abandons

text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living. Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
note: Waiting through hard times; holding on to hope

tags.when_helps: A believer worn down by waiting who needs encouragement to stay strong and keep hoping.

display_text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living. Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
plain: I am still sure I will see God's goodness while I am alive. Wait for God; be strong and take courage; keep waiting for God.
core_idea: Wait for God with courage and hope

text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
note: Sorrow that passes; hope after a hard night

tags.when_helps: Someone in a long night of weeping who needs to hear that sorrow does not last forever.

display_text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
plain: God's anger lasts only a moment, but his favour lasts a lifetime. Crying may last through the night, but joy comes in the morning.
core_idea: Night of weeping, morning of joy

text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.” You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
note: Overconfidence in good times; when security collapses

tags.when_helps: Someone whose confident, prosperous season has suddenly turned troubled, reflecting on false security.

display_text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.” You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
plain: When things were going well, I thought nothing could ever shake me. God's favour made me strong, but when God seemed to turn away, I was shaken.
core_idea: Security in good times rests on God

plain_judge.issue: 'Seemed to turn away' hedges 'hid your face'; direct address to God lost.

text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness, To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
note: Recovery from grief; gratitude after mourning

tags.when_helps: A believer emerging from a season of mourning into gladness, wanting to give thanks.

display_text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness, To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
plain: You turned my grieving into dancing and replaced my mourning clothes with joy, so that I would sing to you and not stay silent. God, I will thank you forever.
core_idea: God turns mourning into joy

text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief. For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away. Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me. I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
note: Grief, shame and isolation; feeling forgotten and broken

tags.when_helps: Someone shunned by neighbours and friends, wasting with sorrow, who needs to know this desolation has been felt before.

display_text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief. For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away. Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me. I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
plain: Be merciful, God, because I am in distress. Grief and sorrow are wearing me down, my strength is failing, and even friends and neighbours avoid me and forget me like the dead.
core_idea: Grief, weakness, and being shunned by others

plain_judge.issue: Drops that the speaker's strength fails because of his own iniquity.

text: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
note: Despair spoken in haste; being heard after all

keywords: cut off from before your eyes
tags.when_helps: A believer who in panic felt cut off from God and needs to hear that such cries are still heard.

display_text: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
plain: In a panic I said God had cut me off and no longer saw me. But you heard me when I cried out to you.
core_idea: God heard me when I felt cut off

text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long. For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah. I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.
note: Guilt kept hidden; relief of confessing

tags.when_helps: Someone worn down by a wrong they have kept hidden, who needs to see that admitting it brings release.

display_text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long. For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah. I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.
plain: While I kept my wrongdoing to myself, I wasted away groaning and felt God's heavy hand on me. When I admitted my sin to God and hid nothing, God forgave me.
core_idea: Hiding sin wears you down; confessing brings forgiveness

text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you. Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
note: Being open to guidance instead of stubbornness

tags.when_helps: A believer wanting guidance who also needs a nudge to stop resisting and be willing to learn.

display_text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you. Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
plain: God promises to teach and guide you on the way you should go, watching over you. Don't be like a horse or mule that has no sense and must be controlled with a bit.
core_idea: God guides those willing to be taught

plain_judge.issue: Recasts God's first-person promise as reported speech; drops 'or they will not come near you'.

text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
note: The limits of power, strength and resources

keywords: a horse is a vain thing
tags.when_helps: Someone placing all their security in power, money or strength, reminded of its limits.

display_text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
plain: No king is saved by a big army, and no strong man by his strength. A war horse is a false hope for safety; its power rescues no one.
core_idea: Strength and armies cannot truly save

text: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
note: Release from fear

keywords: delivered me from all my fears
tags.when_helps: A believer gripped by fears who needs a short testimony that seeking God brought deliverance.

display_text: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
plain: I looked for God, and God answered me and freed me from all my fears.
core_idea: Seeking God freed me from fear

text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies. Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.
note: How to live a good life; honesty and seeking peace

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone wanting a good life who needs plain counsel on honest speech, doing good and seeking peace.

display_text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies. Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
display_fix: Missing capital letter after full stop
plain: If you want a long and good life, don't speak evil or tell lies. Turn away from wrong and do good. Look for peace and go after it.
core_idea: Speak truly, do good, and pursue peace

text: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
note: Heartbreak; feeling crushed

tags.when_helps: A believer heartbroken or crushed in spirit who needs to know God is near in exactly that place.

display_text: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
plain: God is close to people whose hearts are broken and rescues those whose spirits are crushed.
core_idea: God is near the brokenhearted

text: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul. But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom. I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother. But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
note: Betrayal by people you cared for; kindness repaid with harm

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone who cared for others in their trouble and was repaid with mockery and attack.

display_text: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul. But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom. I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother. But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.
plain: I treated them with kindness, fasting and mourning when they were sick as if for family, but they repay me with evil and celebrate my troubles, attacking me without stopping.
core_idea: Repaid with cruelty for kindness shown

plain_judge.issue: Omits the unanswered prayer and that the attack came unawares.

text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings. They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures. For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
note: Seeking refuge and renewal; the source of life

keywords: in your light we see light
tags.when_helps: A believer wanting to rest in and give thanks for God's loving kindness.

display_text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings. They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures. For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
plain: God, your loving kindness is precious. People shelter under your care and are richly satisfied. You are the source of life, and in your light we see light.
core_idea: God's love is the source of life and light

text: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture. Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart. Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
note: Letting go of control; committing your plans and trusting

tags.when_helps: A believer anxious about outcomes who needs to hand over their way and keep doing good.

display_text: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture. Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart. Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
plain: Trust God and do good. Take delight in God, and he will give you what your heart desires. Hand your path over to God, and he will make your goodness shine like daylight.
core_idea: Trust God, do good, and delight in him

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'dwell in the land, enjoy safe pasture' and justice shining like noon.

text: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen. Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
note: Envy and anger when wrongdoers prosper; patience

tags.when_helps: Someone stewing as dishonest people get ahead, who needs to let go of anger and wait.

display_text: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen. Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
plain: Rest in God and wait patiently. Don't fret when schemers seem to succeed. Let go of anger and rage; fretting only leads you to do wrong.
core_idea: Wait on God; don't fret over the wicked

text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
note: Contentment with little; integrity over wealth

tags.when_helps: Someone with little who compares themselves to wealthier but dishonest people.

display_text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
plain: A little that belongs to a good person is better than the great wealth of many wicked people.
core_idea: Little with goodness beats wealth with wickedness

text: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
note: Stumbling and failure without falling for good

keywords: though he stumble, he shall not fall
tags.when_helps: A believer who has stumbled and fears they will fall completely, needing assurance they are held.

display_text: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
plain: God makes a person's steps firm and delights in their way. Even if they stumble, they won't fall, because God holds them up by the hand.
core_idea: Though we stumble, God keeps us from falling

text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil. But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found. Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
note: Power is fleeting; a future for the peaceful

tags.when_helps: Someone galled by the power of unjust people, reminded that such power passes and peace endures.

display_text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil. But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found. Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
plain: I have seen a wicked man in great power, spreading like a lush tree, but then he was gone and couldn't be found. Look at the honest and upright: the peaceful person has a future.
core_idea: The wicked fade; the peaceful have a future

text: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart. Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you. My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me. My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
note: Anguish in illness; friends and family keeping away

tags.when_helps: Someone ill and exhausted whose friends and family have kept their distance.

display_text: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart. Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you. My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me. My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
plain: I am weak and bruised, groaning with anguish. God, you see all I long for and hear my groaning. My strength and sight fail, and my friends and family keep their distance.
core_idea: Suffering alone while God sees all

text: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am. Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
note: Facing mortality and the brevity of life

keywords: every man stands as a breath
tags.when_helps: Someone confronting how brief and fragile their life is, wanting to see it honestly.

display_text: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am. Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
plain: God, show me how short my life is and how frail I am. You have made my days only a few hand-widths long; before you my whole life is nothing, every person just a breath.
core_idea: Life is brief, like a breath

text: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were. Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more.”
note: Feeling like a stranger; longing to recover strength

tags.when_helps: A believer in tears feeling like a stranger, asking for strength to recover before life ends.

display_text: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were. Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more.”
plain: Hear my prayer, God, and don't be silent at my tears. I am only a passing guest with you, like my ancestors. Spare me so I can recover before I am gone.
core_idea: A brief guest on earth asking God to listen

plain_judge.issue: 'Before I am gone' softens 'before I go away and exist no more'.

text: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand. He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
note: Patience in hardship; being lifted out of despair

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
tags.when_helps: A believer stuck in a pit of despair or a hard season who needs a picture of being lifted to firm ground.

display_text: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand. He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
plain: I waited patiently for God, and he heard me. He lifted me out of a muddy pit, set my feet on solid rock, and gave me a new song of praise that will lead others to trust him.
core_idea: Patient waiting; God lifts me from the pit

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'many shall see it, and fear'.

text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me. For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
note: Overwhelmed by guilt and troubles

keywords: more than the hairs of my head
tags.when_helps: A believer so overwhelmed by troubles and failings they cannot look up, asking for mercy.

display_text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me. For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.
plain: Don't hold back your mercy from me, God; let your love and truth always protect me. Countless troubles surround me, and my wrongs have caught up with me until I can't look up and my heart fails.
core_idea: Overwhelmed, asking God's mercy to hold on

text: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
note: Betrayal by a close friend

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone betrayed by a close friend they trusted, who needs the wound named.

display_text: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
plain: Even my close friend, someone I trusted and shared meals with, has turned against me.
core_idea: Betrayed by a trusted friend

text: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God? My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
note: Spiritual longing amid tears and doubt

tags.when_helps: A believer in a dry season who thirsts for God and is pained by others questioning their faith.

display_text: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God? My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
plain: As a deer longs for streams of water, my soul longs for you, God. I thirst for the living God. I have cried day and night while people keep asking me where my God is.
core_idea: The soul thirsts for God like a deer

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'When shall I come and appear before God?'

text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
note: Speaking to oneself in despair; choosing hope

keywords: why are you in despair, my soul
tags.when_helps: A believer in despair who needs gently to question their own low mood and turn toward hope.

display_text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
plain: My soul, why are you so low and troubled inside me? Put your hope in God, because I will still praise him for the help his presence brings.
core_idea: Speaking to a despairing soul: hope in God

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
note: Fear amid upheaval and change

tags.when_helps: A believer whose world feels like it is shaking apart, needing a refuge that holds.

display_text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
plain: God is our safe place and our strength, always ready to help in trouble. So we will not be afraid, even if the earth gives way and the mountains fall into the raging sea.
core_idea: With God as refuge, we need not fear

text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
note: Stillness when anxious or striving

tags.when_helps: A believer frantic and striving who needs to stop and rest in God.

display_text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
plain: God says: be still and know that I am God, and I will be honoured among the nations and over all the earth.
core_idea: Be still and know God

text: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased; for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
note: Envy of others' wealth; what lasts

tags.when_helps: Someone unsettled by others' wealth and status, reminded that none of it lasts past death.

display_text: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased; for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
plain: Don't be troubled when someone grows rich and their household grows grand, because when they die they take nothing with them, and their glory doesn't follow them.
core_idea: The rich take nothing with them at death

text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin. For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
note: Guilt and longing for forgiveness

tags.when_helps: A believer who cannot stop seeing a wrong they did and longs to be washed clean.

display_text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin. For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
plain: God, have mercy on me because of your loving kindness. In your great compassion, wipe away my wrongs and wash me clean, because I know what I have done; my sin is always on my mind.
core_idea: Asking God to wash away known sin

text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me. Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
note: Wanting a fresh start after wrongdoing

tags.when_helps: A believer wanting a fresh start after failure, asking for renewal and the return of joy.

display_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me. Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
plain: God, make my heart clean and give me a new, steady spirit. Don't send me away from you or take your Spirit from me. Give me back the joy of being saved and a willing spirit.
core_idea: A prayer for a clean heart and renewed spirit

text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
note: Brokenness and remorse are accepted, not despised

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels too broken by their failures to be accepted, reassured that brokenness is welcomed.

display_text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
plain: What God wants as an offering is a broken spirit. God, you will not reject a heart that is broken and sorry.
core_idea: God welcomes a broken, repentant heart

text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me. I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest. Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
note: Overwhelming fear and the wish to escape

keywords: fly away and be at rest
tags.when_helps: Someone gripped by terror and wishing they could escape to somewhere quiet, who needs that longing understood.

display_text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me. I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest. Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
plain: My heart is in anguish; fear of death, trembling and horror have overwhelmed me. I wish I had wings like a dove so I could fly far away into the wilderness and be at rest.
core_idea: Longing to fly away from overwhelming fear

text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him. But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend. We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
note: Betrayal by a close friend

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone hurt not by an enemy but by a close companion, who needs that particular pain acknowledged.

display_text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him. But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend. We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
plain: If an enemy had insulted me, I could bear it or hide. But it was you, someone like me, my close friend, with whom I shared good times and worshipped God.
core_idea: Betrayal by a close friend hurts most

text: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
note: Carrying a heavy burden; letting it go

situations: caring for a sick or ageing relative
tags.when_helps: A believer carrying more than they can bear who needs permission to hand the weight over.

display_text: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
plain: Hand your burden over to God, and he will hold you up. He will never let the righteous be shaken.
core_idea: Give your burden to God

text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
note: Facing fear with trust

tags.when_helps: A believer who is afraid of people or a coming threat and needs a simple act of trust.

display_text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
plain: When I am afraid, I will trust you, God. Trusting God and his word, I won't be afraid. What can mere humans do to me?
core_idea: In fear, I choose to trust God

text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
note: Sorrow that feels unseen is noticed

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels their tears and wanderings go unseen, reassured that every one is counted.

display_text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
plain: You keep track of all my wandering, God, and you collect my tears in your bottle. Aren't they all written in your book?
core_idea: God counts every tear

text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
note: Sheltering until a hard time passes

tags.when_helps: A believer sheltering through a crisis who needs refuge until it passes.

display_text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
plain: Be merciful to me, God, because I take refuge in you. I will shelter under your wings until the disaster has passed.
core_idea: Sheltering in God until trouble passes

text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer. From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
note: Feeling overwhelmed and needing steady ground

keywords: rock that is higher than I
tags.when_helps: A believer far from home with an overwhelmed heart, reaching for something more solid than themselves.

display_text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer. From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
plain: Hear me, God, and listen to my prayer. From the far ends of the earth I call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to a rock higher than I am.
core_idea: When overwhelmed, asking God for higher ground

text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken. With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God. Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
note: Waiting in silence; finding steadiness under pressure

tags.when_helps: A believer unsettled by many worries, invited to wait quietly and pour out their heart.

display_text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken. With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God. Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
plain: My soul, wait quietly for God alone; my hope comes from him. He is my rock, rescue and fortress, so I won't be shaken. Trust him always, everyone, and pour out your heart to him.
core_idea: Wait quietly on God; pour out your heart

text: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
note: Not setting your heart on money

keywords: don't set your heart on riches
tags.when_helps: Someone tempted by money or shortcuts, or newly prosperous, who needs a check on where their heart is set.

display_text: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
plain: Don't rely on oppressing others or take pride in stealing. And if you become richer, don't set your heart on your wealth.
core_idea: Don't set your heart on riches

text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
note: Spiritual thirst in a dry, weary season

tags.when_helps: A believer in a spiritually dry, weary season who still earnestly longs for God.

display_text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
plain: God, you are my God, and I will seek you with all I have. My whole being thirsts and longs for you, like someone in a dry, tired land with no water.
core_idea: Longing for God like thirst in a desert

text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined. You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs. You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
note: Hardship as refining; coming through to abundance

tags.when_helps: A believer who has been through long hardship and wants to see it as refining that leads to abundance.

display_text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined. You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs. You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
plain: God, you have tested and refined us like silver. You let us be imprisoned, burdened and trampled; we went through fire and water, but you brought us out to a place of plenty.
core_idea: Through trials, God refines and brings us through

text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation. God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
note: Loneliness, orphanhood and widowhood

tags.when_helps: A believer who is orphaned, widowed or alone, needing to hear they are cared for and can belong.

display_text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation. God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
plain: From his holy home, God is a father to the fatherless and a protector of widows. He gives lonely people a family and leads prisoners out singing, but the rebellious live in a scorched land.
core_idea: God cares for the fatherless, widowed and lonely

text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
note: Daily burdens that are shared

tags.when_helps: A believer tired from daily loads who wants to remember they are not carrying them alone.

display_text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
plain: Praise the Lord, who carries our burdens every day, the God who saves us.
core_idea: God carries our burdens daily

text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck! I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
note: Feeling like you are drowning; exhausted from crying

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels they are drowning in trouble, crying out and worn from waiting for help.

display_text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck! I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
plain: Save me, God, because the water is up to my neck. I'm sinking in deep mud with nothing to stand on. I'm worn out from crying, my throat is dry, and my eyes ache from looking for you.
core_idea: Sinking and exhausted, crying out to God

text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
note: Heartbreak and finding no one to comfort you

tags.when_helps: Someone heartbroken by scorn who looked for comfort and found no one there.

display_text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.
plain: Insults have broken my heart, and I feel heavy with sorrow. I looked for anyone to show pity or comfort me, but I found no one.
core_idea: Heartbroken and finding no comfort

text: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
note: Ageing and fear of being left behind

tags.when_helps: An older believer afraid of being set aside or forgotten as their strength fades.

display_text: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
plain: Don't push me away when I am old, God. Don't abandon me when my strength gives out.
core_idea: A plea not to be abandoned in old age

text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth. Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
note: Recovering after many bitter troubles

tags.when_helps: A believer who has seen many bitter troubles and needs hope of being restored and comforted again.

display_text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth. Increase my honor, and comfort me again.
plain: You have let us see many bitter troubles, God, but you will keep me alive and lift us up again from the depths. Restore my honour and comfort me once more.
core_idea: After bitter troubles, God will restore us

text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped. For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
note: Envy of those who seem to prosper unfairly

tags.when_helps: Someone shaken by envy at arrogant people who seem to thrive, nearly losing their footing.

display_text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped. For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
plain: I almost lost my footing and fell, because I envied proud people when I saw wicked people doing so well.
core_idea: Envying the prosperous wicked nearly made me fall

text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart. I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you. Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand. You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory. Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you. My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
note: Bitterness and grief giving way to being held

tags.when_helps: A believer ashamed of their own bitterness who needs to hear they were held even then.

display_text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart. I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you. Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand. You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory. Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you. My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
plain: I was bitter and grieving, as foolish as an animal before you, yet I am always with you; you hold my hand and guide me. My body and heart may fail, but God is my strength forever.
core_idea: Even when bitter, God holds and strengthens me

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'afterward receive me to glory' and 'no one on earth I desire besides you'.

text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me. In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted. I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah. You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
note: Sleepless distress; inconsolable and overwhelmed

keywords: my soul refused to be comforted
tags.when_helps: A believer sleepless and inconsolable, too troubled to speak, who needs to know others have felt the same.

display_text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me. In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted. I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah. You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
plain: I cry out to God to listen. In my trouble I reached out to the Lord all night, and my soul would not be comforted. Remembering God, I groan; you keep me awake, too troubled to speak.
core_idea: Sleepless distress that refuses comfort

text: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more? Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations? Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”
note: Feeling abandoned by God; doubt in dark times

keywords: has God forgotten to be gracious
tags.when_helps: A believer doubting whether God's kindness has run out, who needs to see such questions within scripture itself.

display_text: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more? Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations? Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”
plain: Has the Lord rejected us for good? Will he never be kind again? Has his love disappeared, his promise failed? Has God forgotten mercy, or held back compassion in anger?
core_idea: Asking whether God's love has run out

text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage. Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings. They go from strength to strength.
note: Finding strength and renewal while passing through sorrow

tags.when_helps: A believer passing through a season of tears who wants to see it can become a place of springs.

display_text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage. Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings. They go from strength to strength.
plain: Happy are those who find their strength in God and set their hearts on the journey to him. Passing through the valley of weeping, they turn it into springs, and they grow stronger and stronger.
core_idea: Strength in God turns weeping into springs

plain_judge.issue: Adds 'to him' to pilgrimage; drops autumn-rain blessing; direct address to God lost.

text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other. Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
note: Hope that justice and peace can be reconciled

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone hoping for reconciliation, where honesty and mercy can meet rather than compete.

display_text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other. Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
plain: Mercy and truth come together; justice and peace kiss each other. Truth grows up from the earth, and justice looks down from heaven.
core_idea: Mercy, truth, justice and peace united

plain_judge.issue: Renders 'righteousness' as 'justice', narrowing its meaning.

text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
note: Longing for a whole, undivided heart and direction

tags.when_helps: A believer pulled in many directions who wants a single, undivided heart.

display_text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
plain: Teach me your way, God, and I will live by your truth. Give me an undivided heart that reveres you.
core_idea: Asking God for an undivided heart

text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape. My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
note: Isolation, loss of friends, and grief that feels inescapable

tags.when_helps: Someone cut off from friends and feeling trapped, who keeps praying without relief and needs company in that.

display_text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape. My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
plain: You have taken my friends away and made them turn from me. I'm shut in with no escape, and my eyes are dim with grief. Every day I call to you, God, reaching out my hands.
core_idea: Isolated and grieving, still calling on God

plain_judge.issue: 'Made them turn from me' softens 'made me an abomination to them'.

text: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men! What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
note: Facing mortality and the shortness of life

tags.when_helps: Someone struck by how short life is and questioning what it all comes to.

display_text: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men! What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
plain: Remember how short my life is. How fleeting you have made all people! Who can live and never die, or escape the grave?
core_idea: Life is short and no one escapes death

text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations. Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
note: Seeking something lasting amid change

tags.when_helps: A believer unsettled by change who needs a sense of a home that has outlasted every generation.

display_text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations. Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
plain: Lord, you have been our home through every generation. Before the mountains or the world existed, from forever to forever, you are God.
core_idea: God is our eternal home

text: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
note: How quickly life passes; mortality

tags.when_helps: Someone feeling the years pass quickly and wanting an honest word about life's length and toil.

display_text: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
plain: We live seventy years, maybe eighty if we are strong, but even the best of them are toil and sorrow, and they pass quickly and we are gone.
core_idea: Life is short and quickly over

text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
note: Hoping for joy after long years of hardship

tags.when_helps: A believer after a long hard stretch, asking that the coming days hold as much gladness as the troubles did.

display_text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
plain: Fill us each morning with your loving kindness, God, so we can be glad all our lives. Give us as many glad days as the days of trouble we have seen.
core_idea: Asking for joy to match past sorrow

text: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.
note: Wanting one's work to matter and last

situations: a career change or new job
keywords: establish the work of our hands
tags.when_helps: A believer starting or labouring at work they hope will last and matter.

display_text: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.
plain: May the Lord our God show us favour and make the work of our hands last; yes, make our work last.
core_idea: Asking God to bless and establish our work

text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.” For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence. He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart. You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day; nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
note: Fear by night and day; finding refuge

tags.when_helps: A believer afraid of night fears, sickness or danger who needs a strong image of protection.

display_text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.” For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence. He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart. You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day; nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
plain: Whoever lives close to the Most High rests in God's shadow. God is my refuge and fortress, whom I trust. He will rescue you, shelter you under his wings, and you need not fear dangers by night or day.
core_idea: Sheltered by God, you need not fear

plain_judge.issue: Specific dangers (snare, pestilence, arrow) collapsed into generic night-and-day dangers.

text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age.
note: Ageing and still bearing fruit

tags.when_helps: An older believer wondering if they still have something to give, assured they can flourish in old age.

display_text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age.
plain: Good people will flourish like palm trees and grow tall like cedars. Planted in God's house, they will thrive and still bear fruit when they are old.
core_idea: The righteous flourish even into old age

text: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence. When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
note: Anxious racing thoughts; being held up when slipping

tags.when_helps: A believer whose racing thoughts and sense of slipping need the comfort of being held up.

display_text: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence. When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
plain: If God hadn't helped me, I would soon have been silenced in death. When I said my foot was slipping, your love held me up, God. When my thoughts crowd in, your comfort cheers my soul.
core_idea: God's love holds me up when slipping

text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread. By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin. I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places. I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
note: Loneliness and despondency; forgetting to eat

tags.when_helps: Someone so low and alone they forget to eat, who needs their isolation recognised.

display_text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread. By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin. I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places. I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
plain: My heart is withered like grass; I even forget to eat. My groaning has left me skin and bones. I am like a lonely bird in the wilderness, a sparrow alone on a rooftop.
core_idea: Withered and alone in deep distress

text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations. Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed. But you are the same. Your years will have no end. The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
note: Fear of dying before one's time; longing for permanence

tags.when_helps: A believer facing serious illness in mid-life, asking for more time and seeking something that does not change.

display_text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations. Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed. But you are the same. Your years will have no end. The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
plain: My God, don't take me in the middle of my life. You laid the foundations of the earth and made the heavens; they will wear out like clothes, but you stay the same and your years never end.
