core_idea: All things wear out, but God endures

plain_judge.issue: Drops closing promise that the servants' children will continue before God.

text: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits; who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases; who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies; who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
note: Gratitude; remembering the good one has received

tags.when_helps: A believer wanting to count their blessings, especially after healing or forgiveness.

display_text: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits; who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases; who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies; who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
plain: Praise God with everything in you, my soul, and don't forget all he does: he forgives your sins, heals your diseases, saves your life, surrounds you with love and fills you with good things, renewing your youth.
core_idea: Remember and praise all God's goodness

text: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities. For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us. Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him. For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
note: Guilt and being forgiven; compassion for human frailty

keywords: as far as the east is from the west
tags.when_helps: A believer afraid they are too guilty to be loved, needing to hear of mercy that knows their frailty.

display_text: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities. For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us. Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him. For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
plain: God is merciful, kind, slow to anger and full of love. He doesn't punish us as our wrongs deserve, but removes them as far as east from west, caring for us like a father, knowing we are only dust.
core_idea: God is compassionate and removes our wrongs

plain_judge.issue: Drops the condition 'toward those who fear him'; makes God's love unconditional.

text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes. For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
note: The brevity of human life

tags.when_helps: Someone reflecting on how quickly a life passes and is forgotten, after a loss or on growing older.

display_text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes. For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
plain: A human life is like grass or a wildflower: it blooms, then the wind passes over it and it is gone, and even its place forgets it.
core_idea: Human life is brief like grass

text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in. Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them. Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses, he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
note: Feeling lost and homeless; finding a way through

tags.when_helps: A believer wandering without home or direction who needs hope of being led to a place to settle.

display_text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in. Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them. Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses, he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
plain: They wandered in the desert, homeless, hungry and thirsty, and their strength failed. Then they cried to God in their trouble, and he rescued them and led them straight to a city to live in.
core_idea: Lost and failing, they cried and God led them home

text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters; These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep. For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves. They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble. They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end. Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress. He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still. Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
note: At your wits' end in a storm; reaching calm

tags.when_helps: A believer tossed by a storm of events, at their wits' end, needing hope that calm will come.

display_text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters; These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep. For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves. They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble. They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end. Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress. He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still. Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
plain: Sailors on the great sea see God's wonders. A storm lifts them high and drops them low until they lose their nerve. They cry to God, and he calms the storm and brings them to the harbour they wanted.
core_idea: God calms the storm for those who cry out

plain_judge.issue: Drops that God himself commands and raises the storm.

text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer. They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
note: Betrayal; love repaid with hostility

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone who gave love and received hostility, choosing prayer rather than retaliation.

display_text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer. They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
plain: They answer my love by opposing me, but I keep praying. They have paid me back evil for good and hatred for love.
core_idea: Answering hatred for love with prayer

text: My heart is wounded within me. I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
note: A wounded heart; feeling insignificant and fading

tags.when_helps: Someone wounded inside who feels they are fading and insignificant, needing that named honestly.

display_text: My heart is wounded within me. I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
plain: My heart is wounded inside me. I am fading like an evening shadow and being shaken off like a locust.
core_idea: Wounded and fading away

text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
note: Hope of light in dark times

tags.when_helps: Someone trying to live kindly and well in a dark time, needing the promise that light breaks through.

display_text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
plain: For those who are honest, kind, merciful and just, light breaks through even in the darkness.
core_idea: Light dawns in darkness for the good

text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.” Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful. Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me. Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you. For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
note: Brought low, then rescued; returning to rest

keywords: return to your rest, my soul
tags.when_helps: A believer who has been brought low by danger or illness and wants words for rescue and rest.

display_text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.” Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful. Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me. Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you. For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
plain: Death had hold of me and I was full of sorrow. I called on God, and he saved me. Rest again, my soul: God has been good to you, rescuing you from death, tears and falling.
core_idea: God rescued me; my soul can rest again

plain_judge.issue: Drops God's gracious, righteous character and that he preserves the simple.

text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom. Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
note: Fear of others; finding freedom out of distress

keywords: what can man do to me
tags.when_helps: A believer cornered by distress or by other people's power who needs courage and a sense of release.

display_text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom. Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
plain: In my distress I called to God, and God answered by setting me free. God is on my side, so I won't be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
core_idea: God is on my side; I won't fear

text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
note: Being rejected, then found essential; gladness in today

tags.when_helps: Someone who was overlooked or rejected and needs to see that the rejected can become essential.

display_text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
plain: The stone the builders threw away has become the most important stone of all. God has done this, and it is wonderful to see. This is the day God has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
core_idea: The rejected becomes the cornerstone; rejoice today

text: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
note: Feeling like a stranger in the world

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels like a stranger in the world, wanting clear guidance to hold on to.

display_text: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
plain: I am only a visitor on this earth. Don't hide your commands from me, God.
core_idea: A stranger on earth needs God's guidance

text: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
note: Weariness from sorrow; asking for strength

tags.when_helps: A believer worn out by sorrow who needs a short prayer for strength.

display_text: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
plain: My soul is worn out with sorrow. Give me strength, God, as your word promises.
core_idea: Asking God for strength in weary sorrow

text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
note: Learning through suffering

keywords: good for me that I have been afflicted
tags.when_helps: A believer looking back on suffering and trying to see what it taught them.

display_text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
plain: It was good for me to suffer, because it taught me your laws, God.
core_idea: Suffering taught me God's ways

text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
note: The limits of perfection; letting go of perfectionism

tags.when_helps: Someone frustrated that every achievement and ideal has its limits, looking for something boundless.

display_text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
plain: I have seen that every perfect thing has its limit, but your commands, God, have no limit at all.
core_idea: All perfection has limits except God's commands

text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
note: Guidance when unsure of the way forward

tags.when_helps: A believer unsure of the next step who needs just enough light for the path ahead.

display_text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
plain: Your word, God, is like a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
core_idea: God's word lights the way

text: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words. My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
note: Sleepless nights; holding on to hope

tags.when_helps: A believer awake through the night who turns sleeplessness into prayer and meditation.

display_text: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words. My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
plain: I get up before dawn and cry out for help, putting my hope in your words. I stay awake through the night to think about what you have said.
core_idea: Hoping in God's word through sleepless nights

text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
note: feeling lost, wanting to be found

tags.when_helps: A believer who has drifted from their path and wants to be found again.

display_text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
plain: I have wandered off like a lost sheep. Come looking for me, God, because I have not forgotten your commands.
core_idea: A lost sheep asking God to seek it

text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace. I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
note: weary of conflict with hostile people

keywords: I am for peace, but they are for war
tags.when_helps: Someone worn out by living or working alongside a person who always picks a fight.

display_text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace. I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
plain: I have lived too long among people who hate peace. I want peace, but whenever I speak, they want war.
core_idea: Wanting peace among those who want conflict

text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth. He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
note: seeking help and protection in hard times

keywords: lift up my eyes to the hills
tags.when_helps: A believer looking for help in an uncertain time who needs to trust a keeper who never sleeps.

display_text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth. He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
plain: I look up to the hills and ask where my help comes from. It comes from God, who made heaven and earth. He won't let you stumble, and the one who watches over you never sleeps.
core_idea: Help comes from God, who never sleeps

text: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
note: worn down by mockery and contempt

tags.when_helps: Someone who has endured long scorn and contempt from comfortable, proud people.

display_text: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt. Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
plain: Have mercy on us, God, because we have put up with so much contempt. We are sick of the mockery of comfortable, proud people.
core_idea: Weary of contempt, asking God for mercy

text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
note: relief after escaping danger

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
keywords: bird out of the fowler's snare
tags.when_helps: Someone who has just escaped a trap, danger or bad situation and feels newly free.

display_text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
plain: We have escaped like a bird from a hunter's trap. The trap is broken, and we are free.
core_idea: Escaped like a bird from a trap

text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy. He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
note: hope that sorrow and effort bear fruit

keywords: sow in tears, reap in joy
tags.when_helps: Someone working on through tears who needs to believe that effort in sorrow will bear fruit.

display_text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy. He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
plain: Those who plant with tears will harvest with joy. Whoever goes out crying, carrying seed, will surely come back joyful, carrying the harvest.
core_idea: Sowing in tears leads to reaping in joy

text: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain. It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
note: overwork, anxious striving, need for rest

keywords: he gives sleep to his loved ones
tags.when_helps: A believer working early and late out of anxiety, reminded that striving alone is in vain and rest is a gift.

display_text: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain. It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
plain: Unless God builds the house, the builders work for nothing; unless God guards the city, the guards watch for nothing. It's pointless to work early and late, because God gives sleep to those he loves.
core_idea: Without God, anxious toil is in vain

text: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared. I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word. My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.
note: guilt, forgiveness, waiting in hope

tags.when_helps: A believer aware of their failings who waits and longs for forgiveness like a watchman for dawn.

display_text: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared. I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word. My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.
plain: If you kept a record of every wrong, Lord, no one could stand; but you forgive. I wait for God and hope in his word, longing for him more than night watchmen long for morning.
core_idea: God forgives, so I wait and hope

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'therefore you are feared': forgiveness leading to reverence.

text: Yahweh, my heart isn’t haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me. Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
note: humility and quieting an anxious mind

tags.when_helps: Someone straining over matters too big for them who wants to quiet their soul and let go.

display_text: Yahweh, my heart isn’t haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me. Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
plain: God, I am not proud, and I don't busy myself with matters too great for me. I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child resting with its mother.
core_idea: A quiet soul, like a child at rest

text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
note: harmony among family and friends

tags.when_helps: Someone enjoying or hoping for harmony among family or friends.

display_text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
plain: How good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
core_idea: Living in unity is good and pleasant

text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion. On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps. For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!” How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
note: exile, homesickness, grief far from home

situations: loss of a home or something valued
tags.when_helps: Someone far from home, grieving what was lost, unable to sing the old songs in a strange place.

display_text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion. On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps. For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!” How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?
plain: Exiled in Babylon, we sat by the rivers and wept, remembering home, and hung up our harps. Our captors demanded happy songs of Zion. How can we sing God's song in a foreign land?
core_idea: How can we sing in exile?

text: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
note: trust while surrounded by trouble

tags.when_helps: A believer in the middle of trouble and hostility who needs assurance they will be revived.

display_text: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
plain: Even when I am surrounded by trouble, you will give me new life, God. You will reach out against my angry enemies and save me with your hand.
core_idea: In the middle of trouble, God revives me

text: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me. You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar. You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways. For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
note: being fully known

keywords: you have searched me and known me
tags.when_helps: A believer who feels unseen and wants to know they are fully known.

display_text: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me. You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar. You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways. For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
plain: God, you have examined me and you know me. You know when I sit and when I get up, you understand my thoughts from far away, and you know every word before I say it.
core_idea: God knows me completely

text: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence? If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there! If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea; Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me. If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”; even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
note: never beyond reach, even in darkness

keywords: darkness is like light to you
tags.when_helps: A believer who feels the darkness closing in and needs to know there is nowhere beyond God's reach.

display_text: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence? If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there! If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea; Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me. If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”; even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
plain: Where could I go to get away from you, God? Heaven, the grave, the far side of the sea: you are there, guiding and holding me. Even darkness is not dark to you; night shines like day.
core_idea: There is nowhere God is not present

text: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
note: self-worth, being wonderfully made

tags.when_helps: A believer doubting their worth or body who needs to hear they were made with care.

display_text: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
plain: You shaped my inner being and knit me together in my mother's womb. I thank you, because I am made in an awesome and wonderful way, and I know your works are wonderful.
core_idea: I am fearfully and wonderfully made

text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
note: honest self-examination

keywords: search me and know my heart
tags.when_helps: A believer wanting honest self-examination and guidance toward a better way.

display_text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
plain: Examine me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my anxious thoughts. See if there is anything wrong in me, and lead me on the everlasting path.
core_idea: Asking God to search my heart

plain_judge.issue: Adds 'anxious' to 'my thoughts', which the passage does not say.

text: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me. Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
note: overwhelmed and feeling no one cares

keywords: no one cares for my soul
tags.when_helps: A believer who feels nobody cares for them and needs permission to pour out their complaint.

display_text: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me. Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
plain: I cry out to God for mercy and pour out my troubles. When I was overwhelmed, you knew my way. Traps are set for me; no one cares about me, and there is nowhere to hide.
core_idea: Alone and uncared for, crying out to God

text: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
note: despair, longing for direction and kindness

tags.when_helps: A believer near the end of their strength who urgently asks for kindness and a way forward.

display_text: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
plain: Answer me quickly, God; my spirit is failing. Don't hide from me. Let me hear of your love in the morning, because I trust you, and show me which way to go.
core_idea: Failing spirit asks God for love and direction

plain_judge.issue: Drops fear of going down to the pit and 'I lift up my soul to you'.

text: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him? Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
note: brevity of life, human smallness

tags.when_helps: Someone pondering their smallness and brief life, and wondering why they are cared for at all.

display_text: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him? Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
plain: God, what are human beings that you care about them or think of them? A person is like a breath, and their days pass like a shadow.
core_idea: Humans are fleeting, yet God cares

text: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
note: after falling or failing

tags.when_helps: A believer who has fallen or is bowed down by life and needs to hear they will be lifted.

display_text: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
plain: God holds up everyone who falls and lifts up everyone who is bent low.
core_idea: God lifts up those who fall

text: Don’t put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help. His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
note: misplaced trust in powerful people

tags.when_helps: Someone let down by a leader or powerful person they relied on, reminded of human limits.

display_text: Don’t put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help. His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
plain: Don't put your trust in rulers; they are only human and cannot save. When their breath leaves, they return to the ground, and on that day their plans come to nothing.
core_idea: Don't trust in mortal rulers

text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
note: heartbreak and healing

tags.when_helps: A believer with a broken heart who needs a brief, gentle promise of healing.

display_text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
plain: God heals people whose hearts are broken and bandages their wounds.
core_idea: God heals the brokenhearted

text: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep. My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lute. Who shall tell my Lord? The Lord himself, he himself hears. He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil. My brothers were handsome and tall; but the Lord did not take pleasure in them.
note: Feeling small or overlooked, yet seen and chosen

tags.when_helps: Someone who feels small or overlooked beside more impressive siblings or peers.

display_text: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep. My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lute. Who shall tell my Lord? The Lord himself, he himself hears. He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil. My brothers were handsome and tall; but the Lord did not take pleasure in them.
plain: I was the smallest and youngest of my brothers, a shepherd who made music. The Lord himself heard me, sent his angel, took me from the sheep and anointed me, though my brothers were tall and handsome.
core_idea: God chose the small one over the impressive

plain_judge.issue: Drops 'the Lord did not take pleasure in them'; the choice is only implied.

text: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary. But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
note: Losing early passion despite faithful effort

tags.when_helps: Someone still enduring dutifully but who has lost the warmth that first drove them.

display_text: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary. But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
plain: You have kept going and endured for my name without growing tired. But I hold this against you: you have abandoned the love you had at first.
core_idea: Endurance without your first love falls short

text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
note: Fear of coming hardship, staying faithful

tags.when_helps: A believer facing coming suffering or persecution, needing courage to stay faithful through it.

display_text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
plain: Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil will imprison some of you to test you for a time. Stay faithful even to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
core_idea: Stay faithful through suffering, even to death

plain_judge.issue: 'Ten days' generalised to 'for a time'.

text: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked; I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
note: Complacency in wealth, blindness to inner poverty

tags.when_helps: Someone comfortable in their success who needs to question whether they lack nothing.

display_text: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked; I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
plain: You say you are rich and need nothing, but you don't see that you are wretched, poor, blind and naked. Get true riches, clothing and sight from me instead.
core_idea: Self-satisfied wealth hides real spiritual poverty

plain_judge.issue: Loses gold refined by fire and the shame of nakedness; counsel to buy flattened.

text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
note: Loneliness, openness to the divine, invitation

tags.when_helps: A lonely believer who wants to feel that God seeks their company.

display_text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
plain: Look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and share a meal with them.
core_idea: Christ knocks; whoever opens will share his company

text: “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood. Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them. They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat; for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
note: Comfort after great suffering, hope that tears end

tags.when_helps: A believer worn down by great tribulation, comforted by the promise that every tear will be wiped away.

display_text: “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood. Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them. They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat; for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
plain: These are the ones who came through great suffering and were made clean by the Lamb. Now they serve God, sheltered by him; they will never hunger, thirst or burn again, and God will wipe away every tear.
core_idea: After great suffering, God wipes away every tear

plain_judge.issue: Drops standing before the throne and the Lamb shepherding them to springs.

text: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.”
note: Grief; rest for the dead, their works endure

tags.safety_reason: Calls the dead blessed because they rest from their labours, presenting death as a release.
tags.when_helps: A grieving believer who wants to trust that a faithful loved one now rests.

display_text: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.”
plain: A voice from heaven says that those who die in the Lord from now on are blessed. The Spirit agrees: they will rest from their work, and their deeds go with them.
core_idea: Those who die in the Lord rest

text: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”
note: Grief and mourning; hope that tears will end

tags.when_helps: A believer in grief or pain, holding onto the promise of a time without tears or death.

display_text: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”
plain: A voice from heaven announces that God will live among people as their God. He will wipe away every tear; there will be no more death, mourning, crying or pain, because the old order is gone.
core_idea: God will end death, mourning and pain

text: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
note: Hypocrisy, judging others while failing ourselves

tags.when_helps: Someone quick to lecture others who needs to check whether they live by their own advice.

display_text: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
plain: You teach others, so why don't you teach yourself? You preach against stealing, but do you steal?
core_idea: Practise what you preach

text: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
note: Suffering building perseverance, character and hope

tags.when_helps: A believer in a long hard season who needs to see suffering building endurance, character and hope.

display_text: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
plain: We even rejoice in our sufferings, because suffering builds endurance, endurance builds character, and character builds hope. That hope won't let us down, because God has poured his love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.
core_idea: Suffering builds endurance, character and hope

text: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
note: Inner conflict, failing to do what we intend

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
keywords: what I hate, that I do
tags.when_helps: Someone who keeps doing what they hate in themselves and needs to know this struggle is deeply human.

display_text: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
plain: I don't understand my own actions. I don't do what I want to do; instead I do the very thing I hate.
core_idea: Doing what I hate instead of what I want

text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
note: Enduring present suffering with hope

tags.when_helps: A believer worn by present suffering who needs perspective that something greater is coming.

display_text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
plain: I believe the sufferings we face now are nothing compared with the glory that will be revealed to us.
core_idea: Present suffering is small beside coming glory

text: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees? But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
note: Hope and patient waiting for the unseen

keywords: hope that is seen is not hope
tags.when_helps: Someone waiting for something not yet visible who needs encouragement to hope with patience.

display_text: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees? But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
plain: Our salvation rests on hope, and hope is for what we cannot yet see. If we already saw it, we would not need to hope; since we don't, we wait for it patiently.
core_idea: Hope is for the unseen, so we wait patiently

text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
note: Trusting that hardship serves a larger good

keywords: all things work together for good
tags.when_helps: A believer shaken by setbacks who wants to trust that good can come from them.

display_text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
plain: For those who love God and are called by his purpose, everything that happens works together for good.
core_idea: For those who love God, all works for good

text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
note: Fear, loss; nothing can separate us from love

tags.when_helps: A believer afraid of being cut off, by death or anything else, from love; assured that nothing can separate them.

display_text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
plain: Paul is certain that nothing at all, not death or life, angels or powers, present or future, high or low, or anything created, can cut us off from God's love in Christ Jesus.
core_idea: Nothing can separate us from God's love in Christ

text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
note: Change, resisting conformity, renewing one's mind

tags.when_helps: Someone feeling pressed into the world's mould who wants to be changed from within.

display_text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
plain: Don't shape yourself to fit this world; let your mind be renewed and changed, so you can discover and live out God's good, pleasing and perfect will.
core_idea: A renewed mind, not conformity, reveals God's will

text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
note: Sincere love and holding to the good

tags.when_helps: Someone wanting their love to be sincere and to hold fast to what is good.

display_text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
plain: Love sincerely, without pretence. Hate what is evil and hold tight to what is good.
core_idea: Love sincerely, hate evil, hold to good

text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse. Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep. Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
note: Empathy, humility, responding kindly to hostility

tags.when_helps: Someone wanting to live well among others: blessing persecutors, sharing joys and sorrows, staying humble.

display_text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse. Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep. Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
plain: Bless people who mistreat you instead of cursing them. Share others' joy and grief, live in harmony, spend time with humble people rather than chasing status, and don't think yourself wise.
core_idea: Bless enemies, share feelings, stay humble

text: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men. If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men. Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
note: Anger, revenge, overcoming wrongs with good

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone wronged and wanting revenge who needs to release it and answer evil with good.

display_text: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men. If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men. Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
plain: Don't pay back wrong with wrong or take revenge; leave that to God. Live at peace with everyone as far as you can, feed your hungry enemy, and defeat evil by doing good.
core_idea: Overcome evil with good, not revenge

plain_judge.issue: Softens 'give place to God's wrath' and drops 'heap coals of fire on his head'.

text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law. For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
note: Love as the debt we always owe others

keywords: owe no one anything but love
tags.when_helps: Someone seeking a single principle to live by, finding that loving one's neighbour fulfils the rest.

display_text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law. For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
plain: The only debt you should carry is the duty to love each other. All the commandments come down to loving your neighbour as yourself, because love never harms anyone, and so love fulfils the law.
core_idea: Love of neighbour fulfils the whole law

text: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
note: Turning from a dark period toward renewal

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
tags.when_helps: Someone ready to leave old habits behind who wants encouragement that a new day is near.

display_text: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
plain: The night is nearly over and day is coming, so let's drop the deeds of darkness and put on light like armour.
core_idea: Day is near; leave darkness, wear light

text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself. For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
note: Facing death; belonging beyond ourselves

tags.when_helps: A believer facing mortality who finds steadiness in belonging to God in life and in death.

display_text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself. For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
plain: None of us lives or dies only for ourselves. Whether we live or die, we do it for the Lord, and we belong to him.
core_idea: In life and death we belong to the Lord

text: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
note: Supporting others who are struggling

situations: caring for a sick or ageing relative
keywords: bear the weaknesses of the weak
tags.when_helps: Someone strong carrying others' weaknesses who needs reminding why building others up matters.

display_text: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
plain: Those of us who are strong should carry the weaknesses of the weak rather than pleasing ourselves. Each of us should please our neighbour in ways that do them good and build them up.
core_idea: The strong should carry the weak

text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
note: A blessing of hope, joy and peace

tags.when_helps: A believer low on hope who would welcome a blessing of joy and peace.

display_text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
plain: A prayer that the God of hope will fill you with joy and peace as you trust him, so that the Holy Spirit's power makes your hope overflow.
core_idea: May God fill you with joy, peace, hope

text: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
note: Loyalty and love that stays through loss

keywords: where you go, I will go
tags.when_helps: Someone choosing to stay loyal to a grieving loved one, or being shown such loyalty, after a shared loss.

display_text: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
plain: Ruth begs Naomi not to send her away: wherever Naomi goes or lives, Ruth will too; Naomi's people and God will be hers, and only death will part them.
core_idea: Loyal love that refuses to leave

plain_judge.issue: Drops dying and burial where Naomi dies, and the oath invoking God.

text: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara; for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me. I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”
note: Bitterness of grief after losing everything

keywords: went out full, came home empty

note: Feeling invisible and insignificant in a vast world
